day_shape: 67 items: IRGC claims a tanker struck a mine off Ghanem Island and warning fire turned back a US F-16, IDF strike targets Khalil al-Hayya's son in Gaza, Trump orders extra carrier to the region, heavy Basij Day messaging from Khamenei and Hezbollah's Qassem, one lone UK Parliament question.

threads.label: IRGC claims tanker mine and F-16 incident
threads.summary: The IRGC said via IRIB that an oil tanker struck a naval mine off Ghanem Island while transiting the Strait of Hormuz, with Defa Press posting imagery of a tanker that exploded north of Socotra. Defa Press and IRGC Aerospace also claimed a US Air Force F-16 approached Iranian airspace near Hanumah Island and withdrew after warning fire.

threads.label: Israeli strikes across Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF said it bombed four Hamas weapon depots overnight and announced the killing of ten operatives this week, including three October 7 participants, while a strike in Gaza City's Rimal district targeted Khalil al-Hayya's youngest son Izz, who survived. Hamas and Defa Press said al-Hayya's wife was severely wounded and six Palestinians were hurt.

threads.label: Israeli operations against Hezbollah in Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF confirmed airstrikes near Ayn al-Tina in the Beqaa Valley, saying it hit dozens of rockets and launchers at a Radwan Force training camp around 25km north of the Israeli border. The military separately said interrogations revealed Hezbollah is using civilian fishing boats for maritime surveillance.

threads.label: Trump raises US military pressure on Iran
threads.summary: Trump said Washington was reinforcing its Middle East presence and warned an Iranian nuclear facility would be targeted if strikes resumed, voicing doubt Tehran would agree to a deal. On a Thanksgiving call with deployed troops he said Iran was being given "every opportunity" to reach an agreement; CENTCOM posted Thanksgiving footage from the region.

threads.label: Basij Day regime messaging cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office pushed messaging on "Every Iranian, a Basij member" and the organisation's "transformation and new birth," while Hezbollah Secretary-General Naim Qassem issued a Basij Day message calling it a legacy of Khomeini. IRGC and Basij commanders Quraishi, Hasanzadeh, Mousavi and Abdollahi, plus Tehran Friday prayer leader Khatibi, delivered parallel statements on resistance readiness.

threads.label: International pressure tightens on Tehran
threads.summary: Iraq closed two more border crossings with Iran this week under US pressure, Sweden Democrat MPs filed a motion to sanction Iranian officials' families and expel spies, and an IISS report counted Iranian operations in Europe running at 12 a month. Arab governments and the European Commission president condemned Iran over a Kuwait drone attack that killed two Italian technicians, while France urged Iran to halt executions.

threads.label: Ra'am and Hamas terror designation debate
threads.summary: Reports said Ra'am chairman Mansour Abbas is expected to declare Hamas a terrorist organisation amid coalition negotiations, and Abbas confirmed he would address the question in an upcoming Channel 12 interview. Itamar Ben-Gvir accused Abbas of "lying" about the designation to "destroy Israel."
